question: Among users who posted at least one question in 2010, find those who also last edited a post that has the word 'correlation' in its title. Return their display names and the total number of posts they owned in 2010.

prediction.sql:
SELECT u.XCL_055 AS display_name, COUNT(p.XCL_026) AS total_posts_2010
FROM users u
JOIN posts p ON u.XCL_052 = p.XCL_033
WHERE u.XCL_052 IN (
    SELECT p1.XCL_033
    FROM posts p1
    WHERE p1.XCL_027 = 1 AND strftime('%Y', p1.XCL_029) = '2010'
)
AND u.XCL_052 IN (
    SELECT p2.XCL_033
    FROM posts p2
    WHERE p2.XCL_035 LIKE '%correlation%'
    AND p2.XCL_041 = (
        SELECT MAX(p3.XCL_041)
        FROM posts p3
        WHERE p3.XCL_033 = p2.XCL_033
    )
)
AND strftime('%Y', p.XCL_029) = '2010'
GROUP BY u.XCL_052, u.XCL_055
